```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.AcceptedAnswerId IS NOT NULL THEN p.Id END) AS DOUBLE) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id), 0) AS acceptance_rate
FROM main."posts" p
WHERE p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND p.CreaionDate >= '2013-12-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2014-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate <= '2013-12-15'
```
